text:
lina: Planning to toggle the feature flag `kv-prefetch-v2` during tonight's quiet window (21:30 UTC). Need owner for flip, monitor, and a rollback plan. Safe default will remain false until we hit 100%.

devon: I can own the flip and the rollout. Proposed rollout: region-staggered ramp (eu-central -> us-central -> us-east), start at 3% for 10m, then 20% for 10m, then 60% for 10m, then 100%. I'll pause between stages to validate metrics.

anita: I'll watch p95/p99, 5xx, and token-cost delta for the first 45m post-flip. Can you post the exact smoke steps and the warmup command?

lina: Smoke/playbook: 1) run warmup to populate KV shards, 2) run 12 curated prompts (mix short/long contexts), 3) verify per-pool CPU/GPU utilization, 4) confirm no regressions in reranker latency, 5) if 5xx delta >1.5% OR p99 > 2x baseline during any stage -> rollback immediately.

devon: Warmup script (will run immediately after flip for the region):
```
/usr/local/bin/kv_prefill --model rwd-13b --input tests/prefill_keys.txt --parallel 12 --region $REGION
```

Some notes: we'll also bump reranker timeout by +60ms in the same rollout to avoid spurious failures. That change is gated and in the same feature flag group.

anita: Dashboard link where I'll watch panels: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/kv-prefetch. Panels: p95/p99 tail latency, 5xx rate by pool, per-tenant request rate, token-per-request. I'll pin it to the quiet-window overview.

lina: Flip API snippet (devon will run):
```
curl -X POST "https://cfg.internal.redwood/v1/flags/kv-prefetch-v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"value": true, "targeting": {"percent": 3, "regions": ["eu-central"]}}'
```

Rollback snippet (ops runbook):
```
curl -X PATCH "https://cfg.internal.redwood/v1/flags/kv-prefetch-v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"value": false, "targeting": {"percent": 0}}'
```

lina: We'll set `safe_default: false` in the config manager so newly onboarded tenants stay on the old path until we finish ramp to 100%.

devon: I'll post timestamps for each stage in #quiet-window and the per-stage verification notes. Also will trigger an automated smoke runner that hits the 12 prompts and posts results to the thread.

anita: Quick preflight Q: any downstream jobs that depend on cold-KV misses? If so we should coordinate to avoid retry storms.

lina: We audited this morning. Only the async reranker job has conditional extra retries; we raised the backoff and added a 30s jitter. Included in the rollout note.

ops-bot: Scheduled: Feature flag change by devon at 2024-07-29T21:30:00Z 5 tracking id fk-20240729-014.

devon: Unless anyone objects, plan to proceed. Owners: devon (flip + rollback), anita (monitoring + alerts), lina (runbook + customer comms). If no objections by 21:00 UTC I'll mark GO.

anita: Good with me. I'll be watching 21:30-22:30.

lina: Cool. I'll prep the support note and leave the kill-switch handy.

devon: Will call it in at 21:30 and post each stage timestamp.
